title: 第六章  公主真香！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

候承天的脸变成了锅底黑。

他整个人坐在那里，身体都在微微发抖，太阳穴上的青筋突突直跳。

他恨不得一巴掌拍死这个不知天高地厚的小子。

但他忍住了。

到底是混迹朝堂多年的老狐狸，这点城府还是有的。

他缓缓站起身，整了整衣袖，脸上挤出一个比哭还难看的笑容。

“好，好，好得很。”

“你们林家倒是生了个硬气的种！”

“咱们山不转，水转！”

“等着...”

说完，候承天一甩袖子，大步流星地走了。

林府大厅里，气氛诡异非常。

林龙虎此刻一团乱麻！

林澈却站的笔直良久后开口；

“爹。”

“儿子斗胆问您一句....咱们为什么要活得跟孙子似的？”

“咱们为何不争一争！”

“明哲保身是不错！”

“可别人往咱们脸上吐唾沫，指着鼻子骂咱们！”

“咱们还要笑嘻嘻说‘您骂得对’，这是人过的日子吗？”

林龙虎饶有深意看了一眼林澈淡淡道；

“儿大不由爹...”

“自己闯的祸，自己收拾！”

“今日我们父子情分已尽，你好自为之吧....”

这话一出口，林澈懵了。

但看着父亲离去的背影，和饶有深意的一眼...

他瞬间明白了。

父亲是让他自己闯，若是真无计可施，或许林家还能保他一命...

片刻后，林澈眼神坚定，朝着林龙虎的背影作揖道：

“行。”

“您不敢得罪的人，我来得罪。”

“您不敢做的事，我来做。”

“您不敢杀的人，我来杀。”

“我不管他是公主还是皇亲国戚，谁敢动我们林家一根汗毛，我让他吃不了兜着走。”

说完，林澈转身就走，背影挺直，头也没回。

长廊尽头的林龙虎转身，嘴巴张了又合，合了又张，半天没蹦出一个字来。

也罢，有骨子血性，不愧是我林家的种！

就是你小子别给老子惹的乱子太大....

林澈出了林府，直奔公主府附近的那家医馆。

医馆里弥漫着草药的味道，靠窗的病床上，躺着一个浑身缠满绷带的年轻人...林忠。

这小子被打得跟木乃伊似的，就剩两只眼睛露在外面，还肿得跟桃子一样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hou Chengtian's face turned black.

He sat there, his body trembling slightly, and the veins on his temples were pulsing.

He wished he could slap this ignorant boy to death.

But he held back.

After all, he is an old fox who has been in the court for many years, and the city still has this.

He stood up slowly, straightened his sleeves, and put on a smile that was uglier than crying.

"Okay, okay, very good."

"You, the Lin family, have a tough temperament!"

"If our mountains don't turn, the water will!"

"Wait..."

After saying that, Hou Chengtian flicked his sleeves and strode away.

The atmosphere in the Lin Mansion hall was very strange.

Lin Longhu was in a mess at the moment!

Lin Che stood upright for a long time and then spoke;

"Dad."

"Son, I dare to ask you... Why should we live like our grandchildren?"

"Why don't we fight!"

"It's good to protect yourself wisely!"

"But others spit in our faces and point at our noses and scold us!"

"We still have to smile and say 'you are right', is this how people live?"

Lin Longhu glanced at Lin Che thoughtfully and said calmly;

"It's not up to the father to grow up..."

"You have to clean up the trouble you caused!"

"Today our relationship as father and son has ended, please take care of yourself..."

As soon as these words came out, Lin Che was stunned.

But looking at my father's leaving figure and his meaningful glance...

He understood instantly.

His father wanted him to go out on his own. If there was nothing he could do, maybe the Lin family could save his life...

After a moment, Lin Che's eyes were firm, and she bowed towards Lin Longhu's back and said:

"Okay."

"I will offend those you dare not offend."

"Whatever you dare not do, I will do."

"I will kill those you dare not kill."

"I don't care if she is a princess or a relative of the emperor. If anyone dares to touch a hair of our Lin family, I will make him suffer."

After saying that, Lin Che turned around and left, with her back straight and without looking back.

Lin Longhu at the end of the corridor turned around, opened and closed his mouth, closed and opened it again, but not a single word came out for a long time.

No matter what, he is a descendant of my Lin family!

Just don't make too much trouble for me...

Lin Che left the Lin Mansion and went straight to the medical clinic near the Princess Mansion.

The medical center was filled with the smell of herbal medicine. On the hospital bed by the window, there lay a young man covered in bandages...Lin Zhong.

This kid was beaten like a mummy, with only two eyes left exposed, and they were as swollen as peaches.
